channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: The clearest wins this period: DOE closed a $490M federal loan for Pattern Energy's Arecibo/Santa Isabel battery storage, Puerto Rico granted approval activating $2B+ in Esencia coastal development investment, and Burlington, Autogermana MINI ($8M facility upgrade), and the reopened $152M Maunabo Tunnel all point to continued private-sector expansion. Real risks warrant attention: the Economic Activity Index has now fallen for three straight quarters (a possible technical recession), a historic drought is forcing rolling water cutoffs and drawing $36M in FEMA assistance, and blackouts are estimated to have cost the economy $1.2B since FY2022.
